baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 2, the possessive lord-title at word 3, the denial verb at word 4, and the dual endings.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative inventories concrete bestowals under an owning Lord and challenges both addressees to declare any of them false.

activation_trace.role: The bestowed-favors branch makes the questioned object a field of concrete gifts rather than an abstract proposition.
The lordship, ownership, and authority branch locates those gifts inside an accountable giver-recipient relation.
The declaring-false branch makes the response an active verdict upon the gifts and their giver.

changed_reading.before: A generic accusation that the two addressees are lying.
changed_reading.after: A dual-addressed demand to identify which concrete bestowals of their owning Lord they can actively declare false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of gift, Lord, and intensive denial at focus words 2-4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordly gifts are acts of repair and completion; their truth is tested in whether the recipients carry the entrusted response through rather than making the charge fail in performance.

activation_trace.role: The favors branch supplies the formative goods whose effect is being tested.
The repair, nurture, and completion branch turns lordship into an ongoing formative operation.
The charge-that-proves-true-or-fails branch recasts denial as failure to carry a demanded response through.

changed_reading.before: The gifts are static objects and denial is only a statement about them.
changed_reading.after: The gifts are formative acts whose truth should become visible in the pair's completed response; denial can be enacted by making that response fail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: All three rooted focus words, especially the possessive lord-title joined to a dual denial construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Oath, binding pact, following liability, and idiomatic obligation converge on a covenantal cross-examination: lordly bestowal places a claim upon both recipients.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch adds a pledged edge to the questioned object without replacing its gift sense.
The split-root liability branch supplies a claim that follows and remains attached to its holder.
The covenant or pact branch makes the Lord-recipient relation binding rather than merely possessive.
The urging-or-obligation branch contributes an incumbent response beneath the overt act of denial.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only whether benefits are factually acknowledged.
changed_reading.after: The question also sounds like covenantal cross-examination: which pledged claims of your Lord will you treat as carrying no obligation?

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured order forbids transgression, passage beyond the created perimeter requires granted authority, and the dispatched flame and copper defeat self-rescue. The threat therefore functions as the enforcement layer that keeps a bounded gift-order truthful.

activation_trace.role: The favors branch is widened from pleasant provision to the preservation of a viable order.
The authority branch supplies the right to set and enforce the order's limits.
The fulfilled-or-failed charge branch lets enforcement prove that the announced limit is not an empty claim.
The just-balance branch supplies the normative architecture whose limits are protected.
The transgressive-overreach branch identifies crossing a limit as aggression rather than neutral motion.
The passage-to-the-other-side branch makes attempted escape a concrete boundary test.
The power-and-warrant branch makes successful passage conditional on conferred authority.
The dispatch branch supplies a directed enforcement action rather than an accidental hazard.
The smokeless-flame branch gives the boundary response immediate destructive force.
The reddish-metal branch supplies the second material component of the dispatched barrier.
The aid-and-vindication branch, negated in context, closes the route of self-rescue.

structural_cues: 55:19-20 presents meeting expanses held apart by a non-transgressed barrier.
55:33 conditions outward passage, and 55:35 dispatches the consequence immediately before the focus refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies balance, non-transgression, conditional passage, a directed material assault, and failed aid; I infer that enforcement protects the gift-order and can itself fall under the questioned favors. A live alternative is that the threat only proves power while the refrain points back to earlier benefits.

changed_reading.before: Favors are pleasant benefits, so the punitive line before the focus is an interruption.
changed_reading.after: The focus can ask which boundary-preserving acts of lordship the pair deny, making severe enforcement coexist with favor because it keeps measured creation from collapsing into transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching and disclosure first provide readable signs; later no interrogation is needed because offenders are distinguished by marks and seized. Denial shifts from a private proposition to conduct that writes an identifying trace on its agent.

activation_trace.role: The favors branch supplies what was taught and disclosed for recognition.
The knowledge-through-lordly-care branch ties readable evidence to the possessive Lord in the focus.
The speech-or-action falsehood branch permits denial to become embodied behavior rather than speech alone.
The distinguishing-and-guiding trace branch frames teaching as the production of readable evidence.
The disclosure-by-speech-or-sign branch makes articulation an evidentiary gift.
The recognition-after-a-mark branch supplies identification without fresh testimony.
The visible-mark branch gives denial an outwardly resolvable signature.
The being-taken-to-account branch turns the readable mark into consequential evidence.

structural_cues: The surah opens with teaching and articulation.
55:39 removes verbal questioning, while 55:41 immediately substitutes recognition by marks and seizure.
The focus addresses the deniers directly before that forensic disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies taught disclosure, no questioning, recognition by marks, and consequential seizure; I infer that repeated denial produces or becomes the mark by which the denier is known. A live alternative is that the marks merely reveal an independently established guilt.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks whether the pair verbally reject external evidence.
changed_reading.after: The focus also asks which disclosures they will falsify when the act of falsification itself is becoming readable evidence against them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counting, weighing, totality, duration, weight, and recompense turn the repeated refrain into a sequence of account closures. At 55:36 the preceding failed escape becomes the newest due item, while the dual addressees carry an accumulating liability forward.

activation_trace.role: The split-root remainder branch makes each recurrence the balance left after what preceded it.
The following-liability branch lets that balance remain attached to the respondents.
The binding-pact branch gives the recurring account a relational obligation.
The not-delaying-to-act branch adds urgency to each checkpoint's demanded response.
The count-and-account branch supplies the surah's earliest explicit calculus.
The estimating-by-weight branch turns accumulated items into assessable measure.
The encompassing-totality branch prevents any day or item from falling outside the account.
The duration branch supplies the temporal cadence in which fresh items accrue.
The weight-and-measure branch makes the paired respondents themselves weighty entries in the reckoning.
The act-for-recompense branch confirms that the sequence closes through answering correspondence.

structural_cues: Thirty non-focus recurrences of the same dual question surround the focus recurrence.
Each recurrence follows a bounded unit rather than forming one uninterrupted list.
At 55:36 the refrain closes the attempted escape and dispatched counterforce before the scene changes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit counting and weighing, repeated closures, the weighty pair, and later recompense; I infer that repetition serializes evidence into installments and makes each refrain a settlement point. A live alternative is purely rhetorical intensification without cumulative accounting.

changed_reading.before: The focus is one interchangeable repetition of a general accusation.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the current ledger closure: which outstanding claim following the prior signs will the two respondents now leave unsettled?

context_deltas.mechanism: Created supports cease, the Lord remains, all dependents ask, and fresh affairs are continually attended to before concentrated accountability arrives. Favor becomes administered dependence rather than self-subsisting possession.

activation_trace.role: The favors branch supplies provisions whose mode of persistence is at issue.
The split-root nurture-and-growth branch renders lordship as continuous feeding and formation.
The milk-that-fails-expected-duration branch exposes the false assumption that provision sustains itself.
The cessation-after-persistence branch removes permanence from every created bearer.
The enduring branch relocates permanence in the Lord rather than in the provision.
The request branch makes universal dependence active and recurrent.
The repairing-and-perfecting-work branch supplies ongoing administration rather than static ownership.
The directing-intent-to-a-matter branch turns continuous administration toward concentrated reckoning.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 contrasts universal created cessation with divine continuance.
55:29 places universal asking beside fresh daily affairs.
55:31-35 moves from ongoing administration to focused address, attempted escape, and consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, continuance, universal request, ongoing corrective work, and focused intent; I infer that benefits persist only through renewed lordly care and that treating them as autonomous is a mode of falsification. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between creaturely mortality and divine permanence.

changed_reading.before: A favor is a completed transfer that its recipient simply possesses.
changed_reading.after: The focus can ask which supports of ongoing nurture the pair will pretend are self-subsisting or guaranteed to last, even as every created support depends on renewed administration.

context_deltas.mechanism: Distinctly formed human and hidden-being audiences are repeatedly held in paired structures. The dual question can therefore stage two answering voices: each response follows and checks the other, so denial is relational testimony rather than an isolated opinion.

activation_trace.role: The split-root voice-following-voice branch supplies an antiphonal relation between the two respondents.
The pact branch places both voices inside one binding relation to the Lord.
The declaring-another-false branch allows each answer to function as a verdict exposed to the other.
The measured-formation branch differentiates the first respondent by a specified making.
The manifest-human branch supplies the visible member of the answering pair.
The balancing-two-things branch supplies a recurrent relational grammar for paired difference.
The concealed-beings branch supplies the hidden member of the answering pair.
The meeting-of-opposites branch models distinct sides brought into encounter without erasing difference.
The companion-pair branch confirms that pairedness organizes the later gift field as well as the audience.

structural_cues: The focus marks both Lord and denial with dual endings.
55:14-15 gives the two audiences distinct creation media, while 55:33 summons them together.
Paired sunsides, seas, gardens, springs, and kinds repeatedly preserve two-ness without simple merger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dual grammar, distinct origins, balanced and meeting pairs, and repeated paired gifts; I infer that the two audiences can serve as reciprocal respondents whose answers expose one another. A live alternative is joint address with no counter-witness relation.

changed_reading.before: The dual merely economizes by addressing two species at once.
changed_reading.after: The dual can stage an antiphonal cross-examination in which each created order hears, follows, and tests the other's answer to the same Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines form-distant attractive-but-bitter plant and deceptive-cloth branches. It remains anchored in focus word 2 and the denial verb, precisely between a destructive dispatch and a rose-and-oil comparison. Render it only as an exploratory warning about misleading surfaces, not as replacement lexical meanings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 and the denial verb at word 4, with the refrain positioned between 55:35 and 55:37.

activation_trace.role: The good-looking but bitter plant branch splits attractive appearance from experienced effect.
The deceptively patterned cloth branch makes visual splendor a possible vehicle of misclassification.
The bare-flame branch supplies the destructive side of the visual transition.
The reddish-metal branch carries heated color across the focus boundary.
The splitting-open branch establishes catastrophe beneath the beautiful comparison.
The flower-and-reddened-color branch clothes rupture in an attractive chromatic surface.
The oil-and-coating branch adds a glossy, unstable material appearance to the opened sky.

changed_reading.before: Visible beauty and favor align, while judgment is visually alien to both.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks whether the pair will deny a lordly sign when catastrophe arrives in beautiful glossy coloration, or when an attractive gift carries a bitter edge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This kinetic reading is surprising because it activates an idiom about an animal running and then stopping. It remains anchored in the focus denial verb and the immediately preceding attempted penetration of cosmic regions. Render it as an embodied analogy for evasive denial, never as a claim that the verse names an animal or literal chase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denial verb at focus word 4 under the attempted escape construction of 55:33-35.

activation_trace.role: The run-then-stop-and-look-back branch converts denial from a proposition into interrupted evasive motion.
The leaving-behind-after-following branch supplies the accumulated signs that attempted flight abandons.
The through-passage branch supplies the attempted trajectory of escape.
The sides-and-regions branch gives that trajectory an enclosing perimeter.
The directed-dispatch branch reverses movement by sending the consequence toward the fugitives.
The negated aid branch removes the means to continue the flight.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a stationary intellectual verdict.
changed_reading.after: Denial becomes attempted flight from accumulated signs until the boundary forces a stop, a look back, and an answer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly surprising because it depends on non-dominant split-root branches for last breath and swollen panting, plus the smoke sense available to the preceding material term. It remains anchored in both mapped focus inventories and the breath-threatening dispatch immediately before the refrain. Render it as an embodied acoustic-affective activation, not as a lexical translation of the focus words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 2-4 as a spoken dual refrain immediately after flame and the second airborne or metallic assault.

activation_trace.role: The split-root last-breath branch compresses the repeated question into the addressees' final respiratory margin.
The split-root panting-and-breath-swelling branch gives the possessive lord-title an embodied pressure point in this model.
The not-delaying-to-act branch turns the available breath into an urgent interval for response.
The life-bearing breath branch establishes breath itself among the earlier provisions.
The smokeless flame branch supplies direct respiratory heat.
The smoke-without-flame branch supplies the complementary obscuring and suffocating medium.

changed_reading.before: The repeated question can be answered at reflective distance.
changed_reading.after: The focus can sound as a breath-measured summons: when gifted breath contracts toward its last margin, which lordly warning can still be deferred or denied?

strongest_changes: The immediate threat becomes boundary enforcement within the economy of favor rather than an interruption of it.
Repetition turns this occurrence into a serial settlement of accumulating evidence and liability.
Denial changes from speech alone into conduct that becomes its agent's identifying mark.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's split mappings kept several live edges at once: favor as oath, remainder, liability, and answering sequence; lordship as authority and nurture; denial as failed performance, delay, vanishing provision, deceptive appearance, or interrupted motion. These support coexisting juridical, pedagogic, temporal, material, responsorial, and embodied readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant mapped branches are packet-authorized but form-distant, so the serial, counterwitness, and breath models should remain explicitly exploratory.
It remains unresolved whether punitive enforcement itself counts as a favor or only exposes the truth of prior favors.
The visual-surface model may be a productive poetic activation rather than a stable semantic reading.
